text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every 
six months as indicated by M6 in the title block
The first draft initiated by eng.
 Amr Gaber, revised by eng. Mohamed Abbas 
 Ahmad, tested by eng Mohammed El-bayaa, 
 accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed Abbas Ahmad, approved by eng. Mahmoud 
 El-Naquib head sector of Ayoun Moussa PS.
This document certified by eng. Mohamed Fayez 
Hassan EDEPC MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category
A work permit must be 
 issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category
Maintenance staff 
 should be well trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety and 
 healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes goggles, and rubber glove 
 ... etc
The board should be 
 isolated from both sides
The main 0.4 kv circuit 
 breaker of the distribution board (incoming) should be switched - off
The sub circuit breaker 
 of the distribution board (outgoing) should be switched - off
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete kit of tools
Voltmeter instrument
Clean dry rags
Test equipment
Work to be carried out
Clean of auxiliary contacts with special type of spray
Check all of power circuit and control circuit terminals for tightness
Readjust the measuring instruments (ammeters, voltmeters)
Clean the withdrawable modules with clean dry rags
